title: Enclosed carrier for a dog without pass

turns.user: I don't have a monthly pass, and I'm bringing my small dog on a tram.
turns.agent:
For a tram ride within Budapest, your small dog’s fare treatment depends mainly on whether it travels in a suitable fully closed carrier:

Fully closed carrier: the snapshot says the dog can travel without a separate animal ticket.
Outside a carrier: leash and muzzle requirements apply. The snapshot’s one-dog-free condition is for a passenger with a valid pass or free-travel entitlement. Since you don’t have a monthly pass, I can’t conclude from this snapshot that your dog rides free with your ticket; it doesn’t specify the applicable dog fare or ticket-holder conditions.

Carry valid animal vaccination documentation. Those cited dog rules are general guidance; the snapshot does not establish every condition for every route or special case. Check BKK’s Dogs on public transport page for the current rule. The snapshot is dated 5 November 2026; I haven’t live-verified today’s policy.

Will your dog be in a fully closed carrier, or travelling on a leash?

turns.user: The dog will stay inside a closed, suitable hand-luggage-sized carrier that can't leak or let it escape.
turns.agent: That sounds like the relevant carrier case: under the 5 November 2026 snapshot, a dog in a suitable, fully closed carrier can travel without a separate animal ticket. Your not having a monthly pass doesn’t change that stated carrier rule. Keep the carrier closed during the ride and carry valid animal vaccination documentation. See BKK’s Dogs on public transport page for current requirements; I haven’t live-verified today’s policy.

Distinguish the closed-carrier rules from those applicable to a dog outside the carrier.
